vlm.face_critique: Good caricature capture of facial proportions, glasses, and expression, though fine skin details are slightly softened.
vlm.secondary_critique: The scepter and tiara maintain shape and separation, but base plaque lettering is degraded and blurry.
vlm.back_critique: Hair braid volume and rear dress folds are solid and follow the concept without major hallucination.
structural_flaws: Unreadable fused text on base plaque
Slight geometric softening on scepter finial
aesthetic_flaws: Lower resolution on gold dress embroidery
Texture blurring across delicate jewelry elements
